build_Mlp: build a Vision Transformer MLP block with configurable hidden features, activation layer, and dropout
create_Attention: create a self-attention module with rotary position embeddings and flash attention support
build_Block: build a transformer encoder block with self-attention, MLP, layer norm, and stochastic depth
create_DecoderBlock: create a transformer decoder block with self-attention, cross-attention, and multi-view support
build_PatchEmbed: build a patch embedding module that converts images to patch tokens with position coordinates
